claim: Per-hook R checks can pass while global R differs, so separate hook R correctness from the original's own R differences and include R in the comparison.

evidence.text: A death HALT's fetch-count difference (6,459 mod 128) explains the full R offset 59, separate from hook R correctness.
Native global R sequences can still differ through idle-loop and IRQ phase while per-hook boundary R is clean.
Moving the speed latch before IFF/R capture needs R corrected for the fetches moved.
Including R in the comparison exposed differences at seven hook sites in the first 400 frames.
Particle and damage routines read R and need it preserved even inside rendering.
A star hook that works out the original's bytes from the plot list keeps R exact with no fixture.
